question: Does the equal pair-condition centroid predict the triple-stress endpoint in both citrus genotypes more accurately than fixed lower-order baselines, including pair-trained amplitude adjustment of single responses?
prior_exposure: CODE1-7 Arabidopsis outcomes known; citrus published qualitative findings and a third-party repeat-layer reanalysis title/metadata known, but no citrus expression values acquired or read by this workflow. New experiment/crop, overlapping investigator network; not an independent-laboratory claim.
feature_filter: Per genotype, mean RPKM across its 12 CT/single libraries >= threshold; pair and target data do not select genes.
identifier_policy: Before numerical QC, exclude all rows with duplicated nonempty gene identifier; empty IDs or nonfinite/negative permitted values cause halt. Do not remove genes using target values. Invalid target values cause a logged stop, not selective deletion.
replicate_unit: 3 biological pooled-leaf RNA libraries per condition, pools from >=10 plants; no matching across treatment by replicate label; genotypes are not independent experiments.

model_definitions.notation: C=CT mean log expression, s_i=single_i-C, p_ij=pair_ij-C, d=mean p_ij; rows are genes; no per-gene standardization or clipping.
model_definitions.pair_trained_scalar: Fit alpha = sum_ij dot(s_i+s_j,p_ij) / sum_ij norm(s_i+s_j)^2 on all 3 pairs and retained genes. No intercept or bounds; if exact zero denominator alpha=0, explicitly flagged. Predict C+alpha*sum s_i.
model_definitions.pair_trained_factor_OLS: For each pair ij and each gene, design3vector includes s_i for included factors and 0 for absent factor. Stack 3 pair contexts, solve least squares for3 shared coefficients using numpy.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None), minimum-norm if rank deficient. Predict C+sum_i beta_i*s_i. No ridge, clipping or target choice.

spans.V3: all3 single-condition mean displacement rows from CT mean
spans.V9: all9 individual single RNA library displacement rows from CT mean
spans.V11: V9 plus all3 CT residual rows (max2 extra independent directions)
spans.rank_rule: full numerical SVD rank using max(matrix.shape)*float64 eps*largest singular value, no target-chosen rank

primary_metric: mean gene MSE for each of3 target libraries, then equal library mean; comparisons always on identical gene panel/target libraries within genotype/scenario
secondary_metrics: MAE by library and equal mean
MSE to target mean (target replicate noise is a common additive constant)
prediction direction cosine and amplitude relative to target displacement; descriptive only

primary_rule.per_genotype: D mean MSE lower than every ordinary_primary_comparator by >epsilon AND D MSE lower than CT in each of3 target libraries by >epsilon. List every comparison, do not pool genotypes.
primary_rule.both_genotypes: Only if both per-genotype criteria pass call this a descriptive two-genotype crop transport success. One genotype only = heterogeneous result; neither = failure of this predefined transport claim. No threshold, model or genotype rescue.

geometry_secondary: Report D gain over withinV3,withinV9,withinV11 per library/mean; decompose total gain versusCT exactly into V3,addedV9,addedCT and outsideV11. This concerns observed estimated spans; CODE7 noise identifiability limitation remains. No disjoint-control diagnostic in CODE8.
oracle_diagnostic: After target opening only, C+P3*(target_mean-C) is the MSE-minimizing fitted target within affine observed V3. Label TARGET_FITTED_ORACLE_NOT_PREDICTION. Its MSE is an optimistic lower bound for predictors in this observed affine span on these targets. D superiority is descriptive and does not identify the unknown true single span.
opening_boundary: Acquire bytes after protocolfixed. Header/IDs only may be inspected for exact sample mapping. Freeze all11 predictors,3basis matrices,genes,coefficients and all6genotype/filter scenarios using only42 non-target numerical columns; verify roundtrip and all hashes plus target-poison check before separate evaluate command reads6 triple numerical columns.
header_mapping_policy: Resolve literal header labels to GEO metadata using treatment,genotype,replicate labels; do not infer ambiguous mappings from expression. If ambiguous, stop before opening numerical data.
quality_checks: nonnegative finite rawvalues; exact48sample header mapping; all3replicates/cell; source SHA256; gene IDs/order; source/preprocessing caveat; real target NaN poison replacement must leave frozen assets identical; independent evaluator with QR and independent coefficient algebra.
inference_limits: No genes-as-independent-replicates p values or bootstrap
No pure higher-order interaction or new true biological dimension claim
Prediction validation uses author preprocessed matrix, not a fully blind raw-read pipeline
No universal law, algorithm novelty, mechanism or journal-readiness claim from this benchmark
Both citrus genotypes use sweet-orange reference; no direct cross-genotype effect-size calibration
Reference-dose discrepancies in primary papers logged; no recovery timecourse RNA inference
followups: Any changes after target access are explicitly post-result. Do not tune or choose donors, thresholds, ranks, coefficient constraints or outcome definitions to improve this primary result.
